ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Dominantly low-intensity (black/dark-grey) surface area estimated at 92%, with localized high-intensity (white) pixel clusters at distal tips and moderate-intensity (mid-grey) circular rosettes scattered across both lobes.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous dark-intensity region across the central fluke body. Distinct, high-contrast white geometric clusters at the terminal left and right tips. Multiple diffuse, roughly circular grey clusters (mottling/rosettes) located in the mid-section of the right lobe and upper-left lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Central V-shaped notch with an acute angle and significant pixel depth relative to the lobe heights.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Irregular, high-frequency serrations visible along the entire trailing edge boundary, with increased pixel amplitude (roughness) approaching the distal tips and medial notch.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strong convex curve on the leading edges sweeping upward and outward to sharpened distal points.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Highly visible circular high-contrast pixel clusters (rosettes) on both fluke surfaces; distinct grouping of at least four circular marks on the right lobe and several faint circles on the left lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint, unaligned linear pixel disruptions detected on the lower-left fluke lobe, appearing as light-grey scratches against the dark background.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle colonization at both distal tips, creating jagged white-to-tan protrusions. Multiple healed circular scars (rosettes) likely from previous parasite attachment across the ventral surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Dense, bulbous clusters of live barnacles at the extreme left and right lobe tips, significantly altering the expected biological silhouette of the fluke's outer margins.
